solicitation.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Accounts Payable Automation Solution

facts.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Accounts Payable Automation Solution

evidence.locator: OHSU procurement bids page; RFI-2027-0824 listing

claims.statement: Synthetic evidence harness can validate required invoice fields and fail closed; no production OHSU/Oracle intake deployment is claimed.
Deterministic fixture logic covers PO presence, vendor match, amount tolerance, and duplicate rejection; Oracle-specific production integration remains unproven.
No verified production Oracle EBS R12 GL-coding integration is available in this carrier; an Oracle-capable prime must supply this evidence.
Harness models approval-required versus approval-present gates; production role/routing integration is partner scope.
No claim of demonstrated Oracle EBS R12 write-back capability is made. Prime/partner must furnish verifiable Oracle integration evidence.
No live supplier inquiry automation deployment is claimed by this carrier.
Harness includes statement-versus-ledger reconciliation as a deterministic hold gate; production ERP ingestion is partner scope.
Exception outcomes are explicit, typed, deterministic, and receipt-bound for synthetic cases; no autonomous resolution is claimed.
Carrier compiles a deterministic capability matrix and receipt; enterprise reporting integration remains unproven.
Each synthetic decision emits a content-addressed receipt and never grants Oracle write or payment authority.
OHSU-specific Oracle topology, interface inventory, security, data-volume, and deployment constraints require partner/buyer evidence.
No unverified touchless-processing, cycle-time, staffing, savings, or accuracy percentage may be represented as ours.
No comparable OHSU-scale Oracle EBS R12 customer reference is asserted for TJLabs/Commons. A qualified prime must own this proof.
A bounded specialist evidence package is proposed separately; no OHSU software/license/implementation price is invented.

commercial_offer.name: Oracle AP RFI Response Evidence Pack
commercial_offer.acceptance: Prime supplies its Oracle EBS R12 architecture/customer evidence plus one agreed AP workflow. Delivery returns a requirement-to-evidence matrix and at least 20 deterministic synthetic acceptance cases covering match, exception, reconciliation, approval, and audit behavior, with zero unsupported customer/revenue/security claims.
